newsitem.title: RUSSIA: AEROFLOT TO CARRY RUSSIANS TO EXPO-98.
newsitem.headline: AEROFLOT TO CARRY RUSSIANS TO EXPO-98.

text.p: Aeroflot will be the main carrier of Russian participants and their cargo in Expo-98 due to take place in Lisbon next year, a spokeswoman said on Friday.
Aeroflot's Luba Kalinina said the company would provide a fleet of planes and extra flights during the international exhibition which begins on May 22 and finishes on September 30.
"We will replace the Tupolev 154 on the Moscow-Lisbon scheduled route with a wide-body Ilyushin Il-86 aircraft and make additional charters at the start and end of the exhibition," she said.
This year Aeroflot added regular Moscow-Faro flights, carrying Russian tourists to the southern Portuguese resort.
Aeroflot's chief executive Valery Okulov said on Thursday his company saw flights to Portugal as very promising.
